blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Applying a legal provision frequently requires both structured rule-based reasoning and sensitivity to open-textured terms developed in case law. The actio pauliana of Article 42 of the Dutch Bankruptcy Act (Faillissementswet, Fw), which allows an insolvency practitioner to avoid transactions that prejudice creditors, requires both. We present a neuro-symbolic model of Article 42 Fw. Its symbolic core is written in Catala in a literate style that keeps statute and formalisation aligned and was developed through pair programming, with open-textured terms represented as boolean inputs where neural components couple to the symbolic solver. A neural routine structures a case's natural-language facts into boolean and date inputs. Neural subroutines resolve the open-textured terms through case-based reasoning over Dutch civil judgments, retrieved through a pipeline that filters on the requirement being resolved and expands along the procedural chain of a case. Segmenting and labelling those judgments attains high precision and recall against a manually annotated gold standard of 100 judgments. On ten hand-annotated cases the neuro-symbolic model handles most criteria reasonably but struggles with the knowledge requirement. Retrieval depth shows no clear quantitative effect, although retrieved judgments provide explicit grounding in prior case law.
blocks.zh: 适用一项法律规定往往要求有条理地进行有章可循的推理和对判例法中拟订的开放式术语的敏感性。 《荷兰破产法》第42条(Faillissementswet,Fw)的cactio pouliana允许破产从业人员避免损害债权人的交易。 我们提出了第42Fw条的神经同义模型。 它的象征核心用Catala写成,其通俗风格保持了法规和形式一致,并通过对等编程而得到发展,开放文字的术语在神经元和象征解析器对等的地方作为布尔输入来表示. 神经常规结构 案件自然语言的事实 布尔和日期输入。 神经分程序通过对荷兰民事判决的基于案例的推理来解决开放式词语,通过对正在解决的要求进行过滤的管道检索,并在案件的程序链上扩展。 这些判决的分解和标签非常精确,并参照100项判决的金本位标准。 在10起手持说明的情况下,神经系统模型合理处理大多数标准,但与知识要求相矛盾。 检索深度没有显示明确的量化效果,尽管检索到的判决为以前的案例法提供了明确的依据。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Research in artificial intelligence and law dates back to the 1970s, and has since often focused on symbolic, rule-based methods, which normalise legal texts into logic-based models that are also intelligible to computers [ 24 , 4 ] .
Today, increasing attention is devoted to data-driven methods, in which AI is used for the automated interpretation of legal texts, document analysis, and the prediction of legal outcomes.
blocks.zh:
对人工智能和法律的研究可以追溯到1970年代,此后经常侧重于象征性的,基于规则的方法,这些方法将法律文本正常化为基于逻辑的模型,这些模型对计算机来说也是可以理解的[24,4].
今天,人们越来越关注数据驱动方法,其中AI用于法律文本的自动化解释,文件分析和法律结果的预测.

blocks.en:
We apply a hybrid neuro-symbolic model to the avoidance action in Dutch insolvency law (the actio pauliana ) as codified in Article 42 of the Dutch Bankruptcy Act (Faillissementswet, Fw).
This provision allows an insolvency practitioner to avoid legal acts (transactions) that cause prejudice to creditors and decrease the estate.
If creditors are disadvantaged in their possibilities of recovery as a result of legal transactions by the debtor, such transactions may, under certain conditions, be avoided by the insolvency practitioner for the benefit of the estate [ 8 ] .
Consider, e.g., a director who sells the company car to himself, months before the company is declared bankrupt, by offsetting the car’s price against a loan he claims to have granted the company.
An insolvency practitioner may avoid such a transaction: the sale was voluntary, it allowed the director to recover his own claim in full at the expense of the remaining creditors, and, as it took place within one year of the bankruptcy, knowledge of this prejudice is presumed.
blocks.zh:
我们根据《荷兰破产法》第42条(Faillissementswet,Fw),在荷兰破产法中的撤销诉讼(cactio pouliana)中采用混合神经-连带模式。
这一规定允许破产从业人员避免对债权人造成损害和减少破产财产的法律行为(交易)。
如果债权人由于债务人的合法交易而使其追回资产的可能性处于不利地位,破产从业人员在某些情况下可以为了破产财产的利益而撤销这类交易[8]。
例如,在宣布公司破产前几个月,将公司汽车出售给自己的董事,用他声称给予公司的贷款抵消汽车的价格。
破产从业人员可以避免这种交易:出售是自愿的,它允许董事以其他债权人为代价全额收回自己的债权,而且由于是在破产后一年内发生的,因此推定知道这种偏见。

blocks.en:
While the legal structure of Article 42 Fw lends itself to formalisation in terms of logical rules, interpreting several of its open-textured terms requires reference to case law [ 3 ] .
For that reason we use neural subroutines that resolve open-textured terms through case-based reasoning (CBR) over a corpus of publicly available judgments sourced from rechtspraak.nl (the Rechtspraak corpus).
blocks.zh:
第42条的法律结构 Fw在逻辑规则方面便于形式化,解释其几个开放式术语需要参考判例法[3]。
因此,我们使用神经元子例程,通过基于案例的推理(CBR)来解决开放式词语,而不是从rechtspraak.nl(rechtspraak bactory)获得的一套公开判决。

blocks.en: This paper’s contribution is a full neuro-symbolic workflow for Article 42 Fw: a Catala formalisation [ 19 ] coupled to neural extraction and case-based reasoning over a segmented, labelled, and procedurally linked corpus of Dutch judgments. 1 1 1 Code, prompts, and data are available at: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23469695
blocks.zh: 本文的贡献是第42条Fw条的完整神经系统工作流程:Catala形式化[19],再加上神经提取和基于案例的推理,这些推理与荷兰的一系列判决分门别类、贴有标签和程序性联系。 1 1 1 代码、提示和数据见:https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23469695

blocks.en: 2 Background: Article 42 Fw
blocks.zh: 2 背景:第四十二条

blocks.en:
Upon bankruptcy, control of the debtor’s estate shifts to the insolvency practitioner, whose powers include avoiding legal acts that prejudice creditors through the actio pauliana [ 8 , 23 ] .
The insolvency practitioner can invoke the actio pauliana by an extrajudicial declaration, and in practice only contested cases reach the courts [ 23 , 31 ] .
We focus on the avoidance of voluntary legal acts under Article 42 Fw, together with Articles 43 and 45 Fw, which provide evidentiary presumptions that assist the insolvency practitioner.
Article 42 Fw can be decomposed into five principal elements.
The transaction:
(a) is a legal act,
(b) was voluntary,
(c) resulted in prejudice to the general body of creditors,
(d) the debtor knew or ought to have known that the legal act would result in prejudice to the creditors, and
(e) where the legal act was for consideration, the counterparty also knew or ought to have known that the legal act would result in prejudice to the creditors [ 31 ] .
We visualise these elements as part of the broader decision scheme of the actio pauliana in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh:
一旦破产,对债务人破产财产的控制便转移给破产从业人员,其权力包括避免通过诉讼对债权人造成损害的法律行为[8、23]。
破产从业人员可以通过非司法声明援引cactio Pauliana,实际上只有有争议的案件提交法院[23,31]。
我们侧重于避免第42 Fw条以及第43条和第45 Fw条规定的自愿法律行为,这些条款提供了有助于破产从业人员的证据推定。
第42条 Fw可以分解为五个主要元素.
交易:
(a) 是法律行为,
(b) 是自愿的,
(c) 导致损害债权人整体,
(d) 债务人知道或理应知道该项法律行为将损害债权人,并且
(e) 如果法律行为是供考虑的,对应方也知道或应当知道该法律行为会损害债权人[31]。
我们将这些要素视为图1中Pauliana行动更广泛的决策计划的一部分。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Actio pauliana model based on Pannevis para. 7.2.1 [ 23 ] , translation based on Warendorf [ 32 ] .
blocks.zh: 图1:基于Pannevis para的Actio Paliana模型。 7.2.1 [23],根据沃伦多夫译名 [32].

blocks.en:
Some requirements of Article 42 Fw are open-textured and fact-sensitive, and are not suitable for purely symbolic representation.
For those elements (green, purple, and orange boxes in Figure 1 ), case law is not just illustrative but necessary to understand how the rule operates in practice. We address the following terms:
blocks.zh:
第42条的某些要求 Fw是开放的文字和对事实的敏感,不适合纯粹象征性的表示.
对于这些要素(图1中的绿色、紫色和橙色框),判例法不仅是说明性的,而且是了解该规则在实践中如何运作的必需的。 我们讨论的术语如下:

blocks.en: Voluntary performance: A legal act is voluntary where it is performed without a legal obligation arising from statute or contract, even where the factual circumstances left the debtor practically no alternative but to perform it. Case law further illustrates the boundary between legal obligation and mere factual or economic necessity [ 23 , 33 ] .
blocks.zh: 自愿业绩: 一项法律行为如果是在没有法规或合同产生法律义务的情况下实施的,即使实际情况使债务人实际上别无选择,只能履行这一义务,也是自愿的。 判例法进一步说明了法律义务与单纯的事实或经济必要性之间的界限[23、33]。

blocks.en:
Prejudice to creditors: Prejudice is assessed when the actio pauliana is invoked, or, if contested in court, when the court decides on it [ 33 ] .
At that time, creditors’ actual recovery position is compared with the hypothetical situation in which the contested transaction had not occurred.
This hypothetical does not concern all possible alternatives, but what would most likely have happened had the transaction been omitted [ 31 ] .
Case law illustrates how this comparison is applied across different transactions.
blocks.zh:
对债权人的偏见: 在援引诉讼时,或在法院对诉讼提出异议时,当法院对此作出裁决时,即对偏见进行评估[33]。
当时,债权人的实际回收情况与未发生有争议交易的假设情况作了比较。
这一假设并不涉及所有可能的替代办法,但如果遗漏交易,很可能会发生什么。
判例法说明了这种比较如何适用于不同的交易。

blocks.en:
Knowledge of prejudice: The knowledge requirements of the debtor and counterparty have been objectified by equating actual knowledge with an ‘ought to have known’ standard, so that the insolvency practitioner does not need to prove the debtor’s or counterparty’s actual state of mind [ 31 , 33 ] .
The Supreme Court further specified that knowledge is present when, at the time of the transaction, bankruptcy and a deficit in the estate were foreseeable with a reasonable degree of probability [ 23 , 26 ] .
Articles 43 and 45 Fw further assist the insolvency practitioner through rebuttable presumptions of knowledge. For acts within one year before bankruptcy, Article 43 presumes knowledge for specified transactions for consideration, while Article 45 does so for acts for no consideration [ 23 ] .
blocks.zh:
了解偏见: 对债务人和对应方的知识要求提出反对,将实际知识等同于 " 需要知道 " 的标准,这样破产从业人员就不需要证明债务人或对应方的实际心态[31、33]。
最高法院还规定,当交易发生时,破产财产中的破产和赤字在合理概率范围内是可以预见的[23、26]时,即为知情。
第43和45Fw条通过可反驳的知情推定进一步帮助破产从业人员。 对于在破产前一年内的行为,第43条假定对特定交易知情以供考虑,而第45条假定对行为知情而不予考虑[23]。

blocks.en: 3 Background: computational approaches
blocks.zh: 背景:计算方法

blocks.en: The “rules-as-code” paradigm builds on the idea that normalised, machine-executable versions of law can improve transparency, consistency, and traceability between legal text and implementation [ 4 ] . Tax law is particularly suited to this approach because its rules are comparatively calculative and contain fewer open-textured terms; Dutch initiatives such as RegelRecht and Regelspraak illustrate this in practice [ 20 , 21 ] , whereas Dutch private and insolvency law remain largely unexplored. Catala is a language for executable law that has been applied primarily to tax law. It brings a systematic approach in which literate programming (annotating the law line by line) and pair programming (a computer scientist and a legal scholar working side by side) are the norm ex ante [ 19 , 12 ] . Symbolic approaches, however, may struggle with vagueness and semantic or syntactic ambiguities [ 4 , 2 ] .
blocks.zh: “规则即时规则”范式基于这样一种观点,即规范化的、机器可执行的法律版本可以提高透明度、一致性以及法律文本与执行之间的可追踪性[4]。 税法特别适合这种做法,因为其规则比较具有计算性,包含的开放式条款较少;荷兰的RegelRecht和Regelspraak等举措在实践中说明了这一点[20,21],而荷兰的私法和破产法基本上仍未加以探讨。 加泰罗尼亚语是适用于可执行法律的一种语言,主要适用于税法. 它带来了一种系统的方法,即识字编程(逐行标注法线)和对编程(计算机科学家和法律学者并肩工作)是事前的规范[19,12]. 然而,象征性的做法可能与模糊性、语义性或协同性模糊性[4,2]相冲突。

blocks.en: These limitations motivate neural components that can reason over open-textured legal concepts. Large Language Models (LLMs), however, introduce their own limitations, including hallucination, poor calibration, and static knowledge [ 14 ] . Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) addresses part of this problem by combining a model’s parametric memory with the non-parametric memory of a retrieved document collection [ 17 ] . This early approach, now commonly termed Naive RAG , has limitations such as over-reliance on or sensitivity to retrieved text. Advanced RAG addresses these by adding pre- and post-retrieval stages, such as metadata filtering, re-ranking, and context compression [ 9 ] . Its effectiveness also depends on how documents are segmented: semantic chunking preserves meaningful sections, which aligns well with the structure of judicial decisions. RAG has accordingly been applied to legal question answering [ 34 ] and legal advice generation [ 29 ] , while LLMs have also been used for legal information extraction and document segmentation [ 18 ] .
blocks.zh: 这些限制刺激了神经元,而神经元可以比开放式的法律概念更合理。 然而,大语言模型(LLMs)引入了自己的局限性,包括幻觉,校准差,静态知识[14]. 检索到的生成(RAG)通过将模型的参数存储器与检索到的文件集的非参数存储器相结合来解决部分问题[17]. 这种早期的方法现在通常称为Naive RAG, 具有诸如过度依赖或敏感地使用检索到的文本等局限性。 高级RAG通过添加检索前和检索后阶段来解决这些问题,如元数据过滤,重新排位,以及上下文压缩[9]. 其效力还取决于文件如何分割:语义分类保留了有意义的部分,与司法裁决的结构非常一致。 因此,RAG被用于回答法律问题[34]和生成法律咨询[29],而LLMs也被用于法律信息提取和文件分割[18]。

blocks.en:
To address LLMs’ shortcomings, we draw on Kautz’s type 2 Symbolic[Neuro] architecture [ 16 ] , increasingly applied in legal AI [ 11 , 30 ] :
a symbolic solver is the primary system, and neural components supply structured inputs and resolve open-textured terms through retrieval-augmented case-based reasoning.
blocks.zh:
为了解决LLMs的缺点,我们借鉴了Kautz的2型符号[欧元]架构[16],越来越多地应用于法律AI[11,30]:
象征性的解析器是主系统,神经元通过检索式的大小写推理,提供结构化的输入和解决开放式的词语.

blocks.en:
The first neuro-symbolic legal system, Split-Up (1995), addresses the Australian Family Law Act 1975 by combining rule-based and neural reasoning across separate subtasks [ 36 ] , much like our routines. Its networks, however, are trained on past judgments and cannot explain their inferences, so Toulmin argument structures provide explanations separately. Our LLM routines can produce textual explanations grounded in retrieved case law.
More recently, Kant et al. [ 15 ] prompt LLMs to encode insurance contracts and claims in Prolog, finding that structured guidance substantially improves the generated encodings. There the LLM writes the symbolic program, whereas our Catala model is written by hand and the LLM only resolves its inputs.
Closest to our method, Sadowski and Chudziak [ 25 ] propose a three-step process of term identification, predicate extraction, and rule application through symbolic verification, applied to hearsay formalised in first-order logic, which outperforms few-shot prompting. Their rule is likewise defined by experts but their LLM determines predicates from the facts alone, while our CBR subroutines additionally rely on retrieved judgments to resolve open-textured terms.
blocks.zh:
第一个神经系统Split-Up(1995年)涉及1975年《澳大利亚家庭法法案》,将基于规则的推理和神经推理结合起来,跨越单独的子任务[36],这与我们的常规非常相似。 然而,它的网络接受了关于过去判决的培训,无法解释它们的推论,因此托尔明论证结构单独提供解释. 我们的LLM常规可以提供基于检索的判例法的文字解释.
最近,康德等译. [15] 促使LLMs在Prolog中编码保险合同和索赔,发现结构化指导大大改进了生成的编码. 在那里LLM写着象征性的程序,而我们的Catala模型是手写的,LLM只解决其输入.
与我们的方法最接近的是,萨多夫斯基和丘季亚克[25]提出一个三步程序,通过象征性的核查来进行名词识别,上游提取,以及规则应用,应用在一阶逻辑中正规化的传闻,它的表现超过了几发的提示. 他们的规则同样由专家界定,但他们的LLM仅从事实中确定前提,而我们的CBR子例程还依赖于检索到的判决来解决开放式词语.

blocks.en: 4 Method
blocks.zh: 4 方法

blocks.en: We propose an approach in which a symbolic problem solver is the primary system. Its structured inputs are derived from the target case’s natural-language facts by neural components: one factual-extraction routine and three RAG-powered CBR subroutines that resolve the open-textured terms identified in Section 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们提出一种办法,将象征性的解决问题者作为主要系统。 其结构化的投入来源于目标案例的自然语言事实,由神经元组成:一个事实-提取常规和三个RAG驱动的CBR子例,以解决第2节中确定的开放文字术语。

blocks.en: 4.1 Symbolic model
blocks.zh: 4.1 符号模型

blocks.en:
Our symbolic core is a machine-readable model of Articles 42, 43, and 45 Fw that, given input variables describing a contested transaction, decides whether the transaction is avoidable.
The model is written in Catala, with the decisive advantage here being its support for pair programming between programmers and lawyers. Our model was developed with the help of an insolvency practitioner and a legal scholar.
Building the model follows the normalisation Allen and Engholm [ 2 ] described for statutes: atomic propositions are identified, replaced by labels, made explicit with propositional logic, and the original text restored to validate the result, in predicate form where possible [ 4 ] .
Normalisation also exposed several syntactic ambiguities; for instance, we model the evidentiary presumption of Article 43 Fw as rebuttable per side. Semantic ambiguities include counting one year back from 29 February, where we round down to 28 February.
blocks.zh:
我们的象征核心是第四十二、四十三和四十五Fw条的机器可读模型,根据描述有争议的交易的输入变量,决定交易是否可以撤销。
该模型用加泰罗尼亚语写成,在这里具有决定性的优势是它支持程序员和律师之间的对等编程. 我们的模式是在一位破产从业人员和法律学者的帮助下制定的。
构建模型遵循规范描述的正常化Allen和Engholm[2]: 原子命题被识别,替换为标签,以命题逻辑明确,原始文本恢复以验证结果,尽可能以上游形式 [4].
正常化还暴露了几种共同的模糊之处;例如,我们把第43条Fw的证据推定模拟为每方可反驳。 语义上的含糊不清包括从2月29日算起,我们从2月29日算到2月28日。

blocks.en: The symbolic model follows the standard decision scheme of the actio pauliana, as outlined in Figure 1 . Some elements, namely whether an act is voluntary, prejudice to creditors, and the knowledge requirement, require more complex case-law-dependent reasoning. Rather than forcing them into further symbolic rules, the model represents them as boolean inputs whose truth values are resolved by neural subroutines.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,象征性模式遵循Pauliana行动的标准决定办法。 有些要素,即一项行为是否是自愿的、损害债权人的、以及知识要求,需要更为复杂的依案例法为依据的推理。 该模型不是强迫它们进入进一步的象征性规则,而是将它们作为布尔输入物,其真理值通过神经子程序解决。

blocks.en: 4.2 Corpus construction
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 公司建筑

blocks.en:
The CBR subroutines rely on an advanced RAG approach, which retrieves relevant segments of judgments from a corpus of judicial decisions concerning the actio pauliana under Article 42 Fw.
The judgments are sourced from rechtspraak.nl , the official open data publication channel of the Dutch judiciary [ 13 ] .
blocks.zh:
CBR子程序依靠先进的RAG方法,从关于第42 Fw条下cactio Pauliana案的一系列司法判决中取回相关部分的判决。
判决来源于荷兰司法机关官方开放数据出版频道rechtspraak.nl [13].

blocks.en:
The initial document selection for corpus construction is made in two steps.
First, we extract a metadata dump from all published judicial decisions through WooZM , a publicly accessible Dutch open government search engine.
We select from this dump all decisions whose area of law metadata is classified as civil law.
This yields over 270,000 civil-law decisions as XML documents.
Next, we apply regular expressions to filter for Articles 42, 43, and/or 45 Fw, the latter two containing evidentiary presumptions; we deliberately do not use ‘(actio) pauliana’ as a search term, as it also denotes the civil-law actio pauliana of Article 3:45 BW, which is outside our scope.
This yields our final corpus of 846 XML documents representing judicial decisions that involve the actio pauliana .
blocks.zh:
初步文件选择是分两个步骤进行的。
首先,我们通过一个公开开放的荷兰政府搜索引擎WooZM从所有公布的司法判决中提取一个元数据堆。
我们从这个垃圾堆中挑选所有法律元数据被归类为民法的决定。
这导致270 000多项民法裁决成为XML文件。
其次,我们对第42条、第43条和/或第45Fw条进行过滤,后两条载有证据推定;我们故意不使用`(actio)Pauliana ' 作为搜索词,因为它也表示第3:45BW条的民法行动。
因此,我们最终收集了846份XML文件,这些文件代表了涉及Pauliana诉讼的司法裁决。

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Semantic chunking
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 语义分类

blocks.en: Rechtspraak XML is structurally inconsistent [ 27 ] , making its markup insufficient for reliable section segmentation. Existing efforts, however, are either no longer accessible [ 28 ] or do not identify the substantive judgment sections required here [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: Rechtspraak XML在结构上不一致[27],使得其标值不足以可靠区段分化. 然而,现有努力要么无法再利用[28],要么无法确定此处所要求的实质性判决部分。

blocks.en:
We therefore build a domain-specific deterministic segmenter. Its lexicon is derived from an LLM-based corpus survey. A separate few-shot prompt is used per court instance. Dutch civil judgments generally follow a recurring structure grounded in Article 230 Rv and reflected in judicial drafting practice [ 1 , 5 ] .
Each prompt receives one judgment in XML and asks the model to identify the opening marker of five recurring sections: course of proceedings , facts , dispute , grounds of decision , and decision . We use mistral-small-3.2-24b-instruct-2506 with temperature 0.1, top- p p 0.2, and seed 42. The identified opening markers are manually consolidated and iteratively refined into a lexicon of heading words and regex-to-label rules. The corpus survey thus informs a fixed rule set rather than making downstream segmentation itself LLM-dependent.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们建立了一个针对特定域的确定性分部。 其词典来源于基于LLM的体谱调查. 每个法院都使用单独的几发提示。 荷兰民事判决一般遵循以第230Rv条为基础并反映在司法起草惯例[1、5]中的重复结构。
每个提示都收到XML中的一项判决,并要求模型确定五个反复出现的部分的起始标记:诉讼过程、事实、争议、裁决理由和裁决。 我们使用迷雾-小-3.2-24b-struct-2506,温度为0.1,最高-p0.2,种子为42. 识别的开口标记被手动整合,并反复精炼成标题词和regex到标签规则的词典. 因此,本体调查为一套固定规则提供了依据,而不是使下游分块本身依赖于LLM。

blocks.en:
The resulting segmenter is a cascade of finite-state transducers in the spirit of FASTUS [ 10 ] : (i) recognition identifies candidate section boundaries using this lexicon; (ii) refinement recovers missed boundaries and removes incorrectly detected ones; and (iii) closing , the final stage, pairs each section start with the next and assigns the text between them to the corresponding section. The resulting labelled sections are validated against a manually segmented sample and subsequently serve as the semantic chunks used for retrieval.
We evaluate this segmentation approach in Section 5.1 .
blocks.zh:
由此产生的分解器是FASTUS[10]精神下的有限状态转导器的级联: (一)识别使用此词典识别候选区段边界; (二)完善恢复错失的边界并去除不正确的检测到的边界; (三)关闭,最终阶段,每个区段从下一个开始对对对,并在它们之间分配到相应的区段. 由此产生的标注部分根据手动分块样本进行验证,然后作为用于检索的语义块。
我们在第5.1节中评价这种分类办法。

blocks.en: 4.3 Neural components
blocks.zh: 4.3 神经元件

blocks.en:
The neural components comprise one factual-extraction routine and three CBR subroutines, all implemented using LLMs. Each routine uses a system prompt containing the relevant statutory provisions and legal doctrine, while the user prompt provides the facts and dispute of the case to be resolved in natural language.
The routines run in parallel and do not communicate. Their outputs are combined by the Catala symbolic solver.
blocks.zh:
神经元包括一个事实提取常规和三个CBR子例程,全部使用LLMs执行. 每个例行程序都使用包含相关法定条款和法律学说的一个即时系统,而用户即时提供案件的事实和争议,以自然语言解决.
例行公事并行进行,不沟通. 它们的产出由加泰罗尼亚符号解析器合并.

blocks.en:
To resolve the open-textured terms discussed in Section 2 ( voluntary performance , prejudice to creditors , and the knowledge requirements ), three RAG-powered CBR subroutines retrieve relevant judgments and return boolean-valued inputs to Catala, alongside a textual explanation of the reasoning.
The voluntary-performance and prejudice subroutines each resolve to a single boolean input.
The knowledge subroutine resolves to eight boolean inputs corresponding to the knowledge and evidentiary-presumption branches in Figure 1 : directly established debtor and counterparty knowledge; transaction at an undervalue; payment of, or security for, a debt not yet due and payable; affiliated party; pre-existing obligation before the one-year period; and rebuttal of the debtor- and counterparty-knowledge presumptions.
blocks.zh:
为了解决第2节(自愿履行、损害债权人和知识要求)中所讨论的开放文字术语,三个RAG驱动的CBR子程序检索相关判决,并将布尔值的投入退回加泰罗纳,同时对推理作出文字解释。
自愿表现和偏见 子例程 每一个决心 一个布尔输入。
知识子程序解决了与图1中的知识和证据推定分支相对应的8个布尔输入:直接确定的债务人和对应方知识;低价交易;尚未到期应付的债务的偿付或担保;关联方;在一年期限之前的原有债务;以及反驳债务人和对应方的推定。

blocks.en:
The RAG embeds judgment sections with qwen3-embedding-8b , a multilingual model previously used for legal example retrieval [ 35 ] , with a 32k-token context window accommodating an entire section as a single chunk [ 37 ] .
We score each judgment against the natural-language input of the target case, using the judgment’s facts and grounds of decision sections. Where multiple sections of the same type occur, as in judgments addressing several issues, maxP aggregation [ 7 ] retains the best-matching chunk for each type before the scores are combined using fixed weights, inspired by the CBR-RAG approach of Wiratunga et al. [ 34 ] .
blocks.zh:
RAG嵌入了 qwen3-embedding-8b 的判决部分,这是一个以前用于法律实例检索的多语种模式[35],有一个32k-token上下文窗口,可以容纳整个部分作为单块[37].
我们利用判决的事实和判决的理由,对目标案件的自然语言投入进行评分。 在涉及若干问题的判断中,如果出现多个相同类型的部分,最大P汇总[7]在使用固定权重将分数合并之前,保留每种类型的最佳配对块,这受Wiratunga等人的CBR-RAG方法的启发。 [34].

blocks.en:
We go beyond Naive RAG by adding the following pre- and post-retrieval steps.
Each judgment in our corpus carries boolean labels indicating whether it rules on each of the three open-textured terms.
For each subroutine, we restrict retrieval to judgments labelled as addressing the corresponding term, reducing the search space and the probability of retrieving irrelevant chunks.
blocks.zh:
我们超越了Naive RAG,增加了以下检索前后步骤.
我们的每个判决 都带有污点的标签 表明它是否统治 三个开放的术语中的每一个。
对于每个子例程,我们只将检索限制在标注为针对相应术语的判断,减少搜索空间和检索无关块的概率.

blocks.en:
To select a model for labelling our corpus, we manually annotated a gold standard of 100 judgments for the presence of each of the three elements.
We compared gpt-5.4 to mistral-medium-3.5-128b:fp8 , and picked the latter as it achieved slightly higher recall (Table 2 ), which we prefer over precision as missing a relevant case is costlier than retrieving a less directly relevant one, in addition to the open-weights nature of the model, which is an advantage for reproducibility.
blocks.zh:
为了选择一个标注本的模型,我们手动标注了一个金本位标准,即对三个要素中每个要素的存在作出100项判断。
我们把gpt-5.4比作mistral-medical-3.5-128b:fp8,选择后者是因为后者实现了略高的召回(表2),而我们更倾向于精确性,因为缺少一个相关案例比收回一个不太直接相关的案例成本更高,此外,该模型的开放性是可复制性的优势。

blocks.en:
Higher instance courts frequently rely on facts established in lower courts without restating them.
At the same time, a lower-instance decision may have been overruled, with the higher-instance decision establishing the final reasoning and decision.
In post-retrieval we therefore expand the result set along the procedural chain: when a retrieved decision belongs to a case litigated at another instance, those decisions are added to the retrieved context supplied to the CBR subroutine.
blocks.zh:
高等法院往往依赖下级法院确定的事实,而没有重复这些事实。
与此同时,较低级别的裁决可能已被推翻,较高级别的裁决确定了最后推理和裁决。
因此,在检索后,我们扩展了沿程序链设定的结果:当检索决定属于在另一案件中提起诉讼的案件时,这些决定被添加到提供给CBR子例程的检索上下文中。

blocks.en:
For reproducibility, the inference parameters were held constant where supported.
For mistral-medium-3.5-128b:fp8 , used in both the pre-retrieval annotation and the neural routines, we set the temperature to 0.1, top- p p to 0.2, and the seed to 42; top- k k was not set.
For gpt-5.4 , used in the pre-retrieval annotation experiment, and gpt-5.5 , used in the neuro-symbolic model, we set the seed to 42 and reasoning effort to medium.
For gemini-3.5-flash , used in the neuro-symbolic model, we set the temperature to 0.1, top- p p to 0.2, and reasoning effort to medium.
Parameters not mentioned were left at their default values.
blocks.zh:
就可复制性而言,在所支持的地方,推论参数保持不变。
对于迷雾-中度-3.5-128b:fp8,既用于预检索注释,也用于神经常规,我们设定温度为0.1,最高-p至0.2,种子为42;最高-kk未设定.
gpt-5.4,用于检索前注解实验,gpt-5.5,用于神经元模型,我们设定种子为42,推理努力为介质.
对于在神经元模型中使用的Gemini-3.5-flash,我们把温度设定为0.1,上-p到0.2,推理努力为介质.
未提及参数在其默认值中。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en:
Each component is evaluated by precision, recall, and F 1 F_{1} against a gold standard annotated manually by the first author.
Due to practical constraints that we discuss in Section 6 , the end-to-end model is evaluated on a small set of hand-annotated cases.
For that reason, we also report qualitative findings alongside the quantitative metrics.
blocks.zh:
每个组件都根据第一作者手动说明的金本位进行精确评价、召回和F 1 F_{1}。
由于我们在第6节中讨论的实际限制,对端到端模式的评价是用一小组手头说明的案件。
为此原因,我们还报告定性结果和定量衡量标准。

blocks.en: 5.1 Prerequisites
blocks.zh: 5.1 先决条件

blocks.en:
First, we evaluate the document segmenter against a manually annotated random sample of 100 judgments, consisting of 582 segments.
As Table 1 shows, the segmenter attains high precision, recall, and F 1 F_{1} across all five target sections, with a micro average of 0.98 0.98 precision and 0.97 0.97 recall; the lowest per-section score is on the grounds of decision section ( F 1 = 0.94 F_{1}=0.94 ).
The segmenter was built through a corpus survey specifically for judgments concerning the Dutch transaction avoidance under Art. 42 Fw, so these results speak only to the actio pauliana of Art. 42 Fw, and do not necessarily extend to judgments in other areas of civil law.
blocks.zh:
首先,我们对照由582个部分组成的100项判决的人工随机抽样,对文件分区进行评估。
如表1所示,分机在所有五个目标分机中都实现了高精度,召回,F 1 F_{1},微观平均值为0.98 0.98精度,0.97 0.97 召回;每个分机的最低分机基于决定节(F 1 = 0.94 F_{1}=0.94).
分包人是通过一项特别针对根据第42 Fw条对荷兰撤销交易的判决的委托调查而建立的,因此这些结果只涉及第42 Fw条的cactio pouliana, 不一定涉及民法其他领域的判决。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Section segmentation performance on the Rechtspraak corpus, reporting precision, recall, and F1 per section against 100 manually segmented judgments.
blocks.zh: 表1:关于Rechtspraak程序、报告精确度、召回率和F1的分区业绩,每节100项人工分区判决。

blocks.en:
Accurate segmentation of judicial decision documents enables the grounds of the decision and the core reasoning by the court to be annotated for whether the court ruled on one of the three open-textured legal criteria presented in Section 2 .
We apply an LLM to label document segments with whether the court rules on these (voluntary performance, prejudice, and the knowledge requirements) in the grounds of its decision.
We evaluate them against the same sample of 100 documents used for evaluating the segmenter, which we also manually annotated for these labels; the results are presented in Table 2 .
We report precision, recall, and F 1 F_{1} -score, but an important focus here is on recall, since for jurists the cost of missing information in a legal context is substantially higher than the cost of reviewing extra, irrelevant results.
blocks.zh:
司法裁决文件的准确分门别类使法院的裁决理由和核心推理能够被附加说明,说明法院是否就第2节提出的三项开放式法律标准之一作出裁决。
我们采用LLM来给文件部分贴上标签,说明法院是否根据裁决的理由对这些部分(自愿履行、偏见和知情要求)作出裁定。
我们对照用于评价分页器的同样100份文件的样本来评价它们,我们还对这些标签作了手动说明;结果见表2。
我们报告准确性、回顾和F 1 FQQQ1}-分数,但这里的一个重要重点是回顾,因为对于法学家来说,在法律背景下缺失信息的费用远远高于审查额外、无关结果的费用。

blocks.en:
The two models seem to trade precision against recall: Mistral reaches higher recall (micro-average 0.94 0.94 ) at lower precision ( 0.80 0.80 ), whereas GPT-5.4 achieves higher precision ( 0.93 0.93 ) at the cost of slightly lower recall ( 0.88 0.88 ), with micro-averaged F 1 F_{1} scores of 0.86 0.86 and 0.91 0.91 respectively.
Given the importance of recall and the greater reproducibility and portability of an open-weight model, we select Mistral, which misses the fewest relevant rulings, whereas GPT-5.4 returns fewer false positives.
blocks.zh:
这两种模式似乎与召回相对应: 米斯特拉尔在较低精度(0.80 0.80)下达到更高的召回(微平均值0.94 0.94),而GPT-5.4则以略低的召回(0.88 0.88)为代价实现更高的召回(0.93 0.93),微平均值F 1 F_{1)的得分分别为0.86 0.86 0.86和0.91 0.91.0.91.
鉴于召回的重要性以及开放量模型的可复制性和可移植性,我们选择了Mistral,它忽略了最少的相关裁决,而GPT-5.4的假阳性回报较少。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Pre-retrieval annotation performance per element against 100 manually annotated judgments.
blocks.zh: 表2:100项人工附加说明的判决中每项要素的检索前说明执行情况。

blocks.en: 5.2 Neuro-symbolic model
blocks.zh: 5.2 神经符号模型

blocks.en:
Finally, we evaluate the neuro-symbolic model against ten hand-annotated cases from outside our Rechtspraak corpus and not used in developing the model, drawn mainly from Jurisprudentie Onderneming & Recht (JOR), a Dutch jurisprudence journal that publishes legally noteworthy cases.
Their facts and the dispute at hand served as the natural-language input for the neuro-symbolic model.
Our symbolic Catala model computes a single output from a given set of inputs (truth values of legal criteria, and dates).
To provide a more meaningful comparison, we compare both the model’s output and its inputs against the gold standard.
We additionally vary the number k k of documents retrieved for case-based reasoning.
We report micro-averaged precision, recall, and F 1 F_{1} for different values of k k .
Because the validation set is small and consists largely of cases selected for publication in a jurisprudence journal, the results should be interpreted as indicative rather than conclusive.
In Table 3 , we compare three LLMs for the end-to-end neuro-symbolic approach.
Micro-averaged scores for all three models fall in a comparable range (precision between 0.63 0.63 and 0.68 0.68 , recall between 0.82 0.82 and 0.90 0.90 , and F 1 F_{1} between 0.72 0.72 and 0.77 0.77 ).
The retrieval depth does not meaningfully affect these aggregate figures: for each model the scores at k = 0 k=0 , k = 5 k=5 , and k = 10 k=10 are similar, even though the retrieved decisions do visibly change the reasoning the model puts forward for its answers.
Neither a clear ranking between the models nor a clear effect of retrieval depth can be drawn from these figures.
blocks.zh:
最后,我们评价神经症状模型与十个来自我们rechtspraak程序外的手写案例相比,这些案例并不用于开发模型,主要取材自Juris Princentie Onderneming & Recht (JOR),荷兰出版法律上值得注意的案例的法学期刊。
他们的事实和手头的争议成为了神经元模型的自然语言输入.
我们的象征性的Catara模型从给定的一组投入(法律标准的真实值和日期)中计算出单一的输出.
为了进行更有意义的比较,我们将模型的输出及其投入与金本位进行比较。
我们还对为基于案例的推理而检索到的文件的kk数目进行了修改。
我们报告微平均值的精确度、回忆值和F 1F ==========
由于鉴定组规模小,主要包括选定在判例期刊上公布的案件,结果应解释为指示性的而不是结论性的。
在表3中,我们比较了三个LLMs的端到端神经-症状方法.
所有三种模型的微观平均得分都在可比范围内(精确度在0.63 0.63和0.68 0.68之间,回顾0.82 0.82和0.90 0.90之间,F 1 F_{1}在0.72 0.72和0.77 0.77之间)。
检索深度并没有对这些汇总数字产生有意义的影响:对于每个模型来说,在k=0 k=0,k=5 k=5,k=10 k=10的分数是相似的,尽管检索决定确实明显改变了模型为答案提出的推理.
无法从这些数字中得出模型之间的明确排名或检索深度的明确效果。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Neuro-symbolic model performance, reporting micro-averaged precision, recall, and F 1 F_{1} of the boolean criteria and the final verdict over ten judgments against the gold standard, at retrieval depths k = 0 k=0 , k = 5 k=5 , and k = 10 k=10 .
blocks.zh: 表3: 神经符号模型性能,报告微平均值精度,召回,以及F 1 F_{1}布尔标准及针对金本位的十项判决的最后判决,检索深度k=0 k=0,k=5 k=5,k=10 k=10.

blocks.en:
Retrieval can provide explicit textual grounding in prior judgments even where aggregate scores remain similar. In the validation case ECLI:NL:RBOVE:2026:4561 , GPT-5.5 at k = 5 k=5 supports its finding that the payment was voluntary by citing ECLI:NL:GHSHE:2006:BC2959 , “where performance of a natural obligation does not remove the voluntary character of the legal act.”
This reference supports treating a gift as a voluntary legal act even if it fulfilled a natural obligation, as the court explains in paragraph 7.5 of the retrieved judgment.
Since GPT-5.5 already reaches the same conclusion at k = 0 k=0 , the visible addition is primarily explicit, verifiable grounding in prior case law.
blocks.zh:
即使总得分仍然相似,检索也可以在先前的判决中提供明确的文字依据。 在ECLI:NL:RBOVE:2026:4561,GPT-5.5 at k = 5 k = 5的验证案中,GPT-5.5支持其结论,引用了ECLI:NL:GHSHE:2006:BC2959, “履行自然义务并不消除法律行为的自愿性质”。
正如法院在收回的判决第7.5段中所解释的,这种提法支持将馈赠视为一种自愿的法律行为,即使它履行了一项自然义务。
由于GPT-5.5在k=0k=0时已经得出相同的结论,可见的添加主要是在之前的判例法中明确,可核查的根据.

blocks.en:
In another case, JOR 2026/137, GPT-5.5 at k = 5 k=5 cites ECLI:NL:GHLEE:2007: BB3627 to support its finding that the onward payment to a third party fulfilled an existing obligation.
The court itself refers to the same judgment as a “somewhat comparable case” in footnote 1 to paragraph 3.4.
The retrieval step of the neuro-symbolic model thus surfaces a legally relevant case that the court itself also cites in the gold standard.
blocks.zh:
在另一起案件中,JOR 2026/137,GPT-5.5 at k = 5 k = 5 引用ECLI:NL:GHLEE:2007:BB3627来支持其结论,即对第三方的继续付款履行了现有义务。
法院本身在第3.4段脚注1中将同一判决称为“一些相当的案件”。
因此,神经系统模型的检索步骤揭示了法院本身在金本位法中也援引的一个法律相关案件。

blocks.en:
To better understand the model’s performance, we break down the results per CBR subroutine in Table 4 .
The voluntary-performance and prejudice subroutines reach high recall and moderate-to-high F 1 F_{1} across all three models, whereas the knowledge subroutine attains markedly lower precision, recall, and F 1 F_{1} throughout.
For the knowledge subroutine, only Gemini scores slightly higher at k = 5 k=5 than at k = 0 k=0 . The other two models remain largely unchanged, so the retrieved prior decisions do not systematically raise performance on this element.
blocks.zh:
为了更好地了解模型的性能,我们将表4中每个CBR子例程的结果进行细分.
在所有三种模式中,自愿业绩和偏见子程序达到高召回和中高F 1 F Q Q {1},而知识子程序在整个过程中的精度、召回和F 1 F _{1}则明显较低。
对于知识子例程,只有双子座的得分在k=5k=5时略高于k=0k=0. 其他两种模式基本上保持不变,因此检索到的先前决定没有系统地提高这方面的业绩。

blocks.en: Table 4 : Per-subroutine micro-averaged precision, recall, and F 1 F_{1} at retrieval depths k = 0 k=0 , k = 5 k=5 , and k = 10 k=10 .
blocks.zh: 表4:在检索深度k=0k=0,k=5k=5,k=10k=10时,每个子例程的微平均精度,召回,F 1 F_{1}.

blocks.en:
shows differences in how the models reach their conclusions. In JOR 2026/137, GPT-5.5 and Gemini at k = 5 k=5 cite ECLI:NL:GHSHE:2014:4568 to reach opposite conclusions on prejudice to creditors.
Gemini follows the insolvency practitioner’s argument: the onward payment to a third party removes funds available to the general body of creditors, and it applies ECLI:NL:GHSHE:2014:4568 by analogy.
GPT-5.5 instead distinguishes the present case from that precedent, treating the onward payment as putting right a mistake made by the bank, and finds no prejudice, in line with the court in the gold standard.
The same case-law reference can thus, particularly in hard cases, support different but defensible positions grounded in prior judgments.
blocks.zh:
显示模型如何得出结论的差异。 在JOR 2026/137中,GPT-5.5和双子座在k = 5 k = 5中引用ECLI:NL:GHSHE:2014:4568,得出对债权人的偏见的相反结论.
双子公司遵循破产从业者的论点:向第三方继续付款可以消除一般债权人机构的资金,它通过类推适用ECLI:NL:GHSHE:2014:4568.
相反,GPT-5.5将本案与该先例区分开来,将向上付款视为纠正了银行所犯的错误,并且按照金本位法院的规定,认为没有偏见。
因此,同样的判例法参考可以支持基于先前判决的不同但站得住脚的立场,特别是在困难案件中。

blocks.en:
In JOR 2014/78, all three models at k = 5 k=5 find the debtor’s knowledge of prejudice unproven, leading the symbolic model to an incorrect verdict that the transaction is not avoidable. The court instead treats knowledge as established because it was insufficiently disputed, a finding that is hard to infer from the model input. This is consistent with Nouwens et al.’s [ 22 ] observation that imperfect accuracy may reflect differences between the knowledge available to the system and the human decision-maker. Mistral’s explanation adds a second error: it invokes the evidentiary presumption by incorrectly placing the 2005 legal act within one year of the 2009 bankruptcy order. The symbolic model correctly rejects the presumption because the dates are over one year apart, but the explanation is not updated accordingly. Such drift in textual explanations follows from the loose symbolic-neural coupling and could be addressed in future work through chain-of-thought prompting.
The same incorrect verdict thus masks different reasoning failures that boolean scores alone cannot distinguish.
blocks.zh:
在JOR 2014/78中,K = 5 k = 5的所有三种模型都发现债务人对偏见的了解没有被证明,导致象征性模型得出交易不可撤销的错误判断. 相反,法院视知识为确定的,因为它没有得到充分争议,从模型输入中很难推断出这一结论。 这符合Nouwens等人[22]的意见,即不完善的准确性可能反映系统所掌握的知识与人类决策者之间的差异。 Mistral的解释增加了第二个错误:它引用了证据推定,错误地将2005年的法律行为置于2009年破产令的一年之内。 象征性模式正确地拒绝了这一推定,因为日期相隔一年以上,但解释没有相应更新。 文字解释的这种偏移源于松散的符号-神经耦合,可在今后的工作中通过启发思考来解决。
因此,同样的错误判断掩盖了不同的推理失误,而仅布尔得分无法区分。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We show how Article 42 Fw can be modelled neuro-symbolically by combining a symbolic Catala model that follows the decision scheme of the actio pauliana with neural routines for factual extraction and open-textured legal reasoning. A pipeline for collecting, segmenting, and LLM-labelling judgments provides the corpus used for retrieval, with both segmentation and labelling performing strongly against our gold standard.
blocks.zh: 我们展示一下第四十二条 Fw可以通过将一个遵循cactio Pauliana决定方案的象征性Catara模型与神经常规相结合,用于事实提取和开放式法律推理,从而模拟神经-同义. 收集、分解和LLM标签判决的管道提供了用于检索的工具,其分解和标签都强烈违反我们的金本位。

blocks.en: On ten hard, out-of-corpus validation cases, performance of the neuro-symbolic model is strongest for voluntary performance and prejudice to creditors, while the results indicate particular difficulty in resolving the knowledge requirement. Increasing retrieval depth does not yield a clear quantitative improvement, but upon inspection, retrieved judgments do seem to strengthen the model’s textual reasoning through explicit and legally relevant grounding in prior case law.
blocks.zh: 在10个硬的,公司外的验证案例中,神经元模型的性能对于自愿的性能和对债权人的偏见最强,而结果表明解决知识要求特别困难. 检索深度的提高并没有产生明确的量化改进,但通过检查,检索到的判决似乎通过在以往判例法中明确和具有法律相关性的依据,加强了模型的文字推理。

blocks.en:
The present court-centric evaluation captures only one way in which the model may be assessed. The validation set consists largely of cases published in a jurisprudence journal precisely because they are legally interesting, and is therefore skewed towards harder cases.
Uncontested, routine cases are settled by an extrajudicial declaration and therefore leave no public record, so they could not be evaluated. In the harder cases that do reach the courts, a model conclusion that differs from the court may still reflect a defensible argument for the opposing side, as the qualitative inspection of the model’s reasoning illustrates. Future work should therefore evaluate the model with insolvency practitioners, who can steer its inputs and argumentation and thereby enable further validation of its legal reasoning.
blocks.zh:
目前以法院为中心的评价只掌握了一种评估模式的方法。 这套鉴定程序主要是在一份判例期刊上公布的案件,正因为这些案件在法律上是有意义的,因此偏向于更困难的案件。
未经论证的例行案件通过法外申报解决,因此没有公开记录,因此无法评估。 在诉诸法院的较困难的案件中,与法院不同的示范结论仍然可能反映反对方的站得住脚的论点,对模型推理的质量检查就说明了这一点。 因此,今后的工作应当与破产从业人员一起评价这一模式,后者能够指导其投入和论证,从而能够进一步验证其法律推理。
